title: 第11章 土著！治疗丧尸病毒的药剂！
slug: 万界词条从基因锁词条开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

哒哒哒！

子弹从枪管激射而出，洞穿了一个又一个丧尸的身体。

罗兰端着枪直接来了个三百六十度转身横扫！

周围的丧尸，顿时像是麦田中被劲风吹过的麦子一般倒伏了下去！

哒哒哒！

“痛快！”

看着丧尸飞速倒下，罗兰嘴角露出一丝微笑。

只是短短几秒钟的时间，就有十几头丧尸死在了他的手中。

这种效率，比他用刀快太多了！

不过，如此快的效率，消耗的子弹自然也是很多。

很快，十秒过去，罗兰手中的自动步枪就没有任何动静了。

“子弹消耗完了。”

罗兰看了一眼手中的自动步枪，随即将其直接扔在了地上。

没有子弹的枪械，和废品没有区别。

除非他能将这些枪械带回聚集地卖掉，否则对他无用。

不过在聚集地，枪械的价格不算贵，贵的是子弹。

扔掉手中步枪，看着即将再度合围上来的丧尸，罗兰手持长刀，便直接朝着回来的路冲了过去。

有丧尸拦路，他也不杀，只是用最快最简单的方法让这些丧尸失去行动力，人为的制造出了一些路障，阻拦后面丧尸的追赶。

只见任何出现在罗兰身边的丧尸，都被他用长刀或是切断腿部肌肉，或是直接敲断膝盖，让这些丧尸一个个倒了下去。

倒在地上的丧尸还在挣扎着移动，而它们的挣扎，却在无意中对其他丧尸造成了阻碍。

罗兰势如破竹，快速逼近公寓楼，而就在这个时候，几声急促的声音从他右侧不远处响起。

“这边！这边！”

罗兰一怔，旋即扭头一看，顿时看到右侧街道上，一栋三层高的居民楼大门此刻微微

“活人？土著？”

罗兰目光一闪，旋即骤然改变方向，朝着女人所在的居民楼快速跑去。

虽然这个女人说的是这个试炼世界的语言，但是罗兰却能听懂。

不因为别的，只因为每个觉醒了数据面板的人，蓝星意志都会为其附加一种【语言通晓】的能力！

任何语言文字，只要不涉及到超凡力量，觉醒了数据面板的人，都能听懂看懂！

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Ta-ta-ta!

Bullets shot out from the barrel and penetrated the bodies of zombies one after another.

Roland held the gun and turned 360 degrees to sweep across!

The surrounding zombies suddenly fell down like wheat blown by the strong wind in a wheat field!

Ta-ta-ta!

"Happy!"

Seeing the zombies falling rapidly, Roland showed a smile.

In just a few seconds, more than a dozen zombies died in his hands.

This kind of efficiency is much faster than using a knife!

However, such a fast efficiency naturally consumes a lot of bullets.

Soon, ten seconds passed, and there was no movement from the automatic rifle in Roland's hand.

"The bullets are gone."

Roland glanced at the automatic rifle in his hand, and then threw it directly to the ground.

Firearms without bullets are no different from junk.

The firearms were of no use to him unless he could bring them back to the gathering place and sell them.

However, in gathering areas, the price of firearms is not expensive, but bullets are expensive.

Throwing away the rifle in his hand and looking at the zombies that were about to encircle him again, Roland held a long knife and rushed towards the way back.

If there were zombies blocking the road, he would not kill them. He would just use the fastest and simplest method to make these zombies incapacitated, and artificially create some roadblocks to prevent the zombies from chasing after them.

Any zombie that appeared next to Roland had his leg muscles cut off with a long knife, or his knees were directly broken, causing these zombies to fall down one by one.

The zombies that fell on the ground were still struggling to move, and their struggles inadvertently hindered other zombies.

Roland was approaching the apartment building quickly, and at this moment, several urgent sounds sounded from not far away from his right side.

"This way! This way!"

Roland was startled, then turned around and saw the door of a three-story residential building on the street on the right.

"Living people? Aboriginals?"

Roland's eyes flashed, and he suddenly changed direction and ran quickly towards the residential building where the woman was.

Although this woman spoke the language of this trial world, Roland could understand it.

Not because of anything else, just because Blue Star Will will add a [Language Proficiency] ability to everyone who awakens the data panel!

Any language and text, as long as it does not involve extraordinary power, can be understood by people who have awakened the data panel!
